about: S-74: what a public build may carry besides Silhouette's own presets -- only the presets CBBE and BodyTalk themselves ship, so a release never carries the presets of the machine it was built on. Names as the mods' own files spell them: CBBE's Tools/BodySlide/SliderPresets/CBBE.xml (Caliente's Beautiful Bodies Enhancer 2.7.2, Nexus 15) and BodyTalk's BT-*.xml (BodyTalk 3.8, Nexus 72310). Their '(Outfit)' variants are left out by the generator anyway.
